speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're having trouble feeding and your belly looks swollen. Have you noticed any vomiting, and if so, does it look like it contains bile (green)?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has he passed any stool or urine recently, and what does it look like? REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_X-Ray. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound.

speaker: Patient
text: There has not been fever, vomiting, or diarrhea like a stomach infection. The baby was born at 39 weeks without birth complications.

speaker: Patient
text: The baby did not seem to pass stool normally and the belly swelling has become more obvious. Feeding has clearly decreased over the past few days.

speaker: Patient
text: The abdomen still looks swollen and the baby seems uncomfortable, especially in the lower abdomen. You must output exactly the following diagnosis: DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception
